tool_descriptors.description: 步行/骑行办事路线规划。 read_tasks supplies store_id/versions and exact task fields incl.priority/place/address. task_versions keys=request.tasks IDs; place XOR place_type; no snapshot. Read-only: no todo edits/confirmation/navigation; removed stop stays pending. Result /data/plan_id; /data/plan=intermediate stops, legs to destination, times/totals/warnings; geometry_ref reads full geometry. Publish exact facts/warnings; extra prose in summary. navigation_started=false; new revision=new receipt. Z=UTC; label/convert timezone in prose.
按 content_ref/version 读取成果缺失段；旧成果仅供参考。offset 为字符，页最多 2400 UTF-8 字节，用 next_offset 续读。
读取正式待办。store_id/revision/task_versions identify business state, independent of Agent revisions; preserve exact task fields/versions. Read-only, not completion.
只读查询原能力执行编号 run_id 的当前状态和已核实设备回执。请求已记录或已确认不代表设备已执行；仅 device_execution_observed=true 且匹配 result 回执可证明设备行为。不会确认、派发、重试、核实新回执或启动导航。
按城市搜索真实地点、门店或旅行景点，返回地点身份和坐标。先搜索再使用地点；结果不证明营业时间或预约可用性。
按result_ref读缺失事实：结构字段优先用paths（原result的JSON Pointer，非decoded_path）；否则offset/max_chars字符分页，按next_offset续读。最多2400 UTF-8字节，勿重读。
